title: Rust: ccp16-desync.json vector consumer + R-02a-079 FSM conformance tests (slice of b7z9.25)
description: Smallest Rust slice of b7z9.25 (decompose-first): no Rust consumer exists for test/vectors/ccp16-desync.json (only python/tests/test_ccp_sync_vector_consumers.py:290-386). Add a Rust consumer test in lichen-node (or lichen-core where the multi_instance/sfn FSMs live) driving the desync_on_sfn_wrap, multi_root_version_conflict_desync, excessive_clock_drift_desync, and desync_recovery_beacon_revalidate cases against lichen-rpl::multi_instance and the desync FSM, matching the python DesyncFSM oracle. C consumer already landed (lichen/tests/desync_fsm, bead b7z9.12.5).
close_reason: Rust ccp16-desync.json consumer landed: lichen-core/tests/ccp16_desync_vectors.rs drives lichen_core::desync::DesyncFSM against all 4 vectors — desync_on_sfn_wrap (incl. the vector's core u32 wrapping_sub arithmetic assert: 0-65536 wraps to 4294901761, python test_ccp_sync_vector_consumers parity), desync_recovery_beacon_revalidate (recovering re-entry, invalid-beacon reset, 3-consecutive-valid->Synced), plus semantics-pinning for excessive_clock_drift_desync and multi_root_version_conflict_desync explicitly labeled as such (the FSM-drive for those lives in the gradient/root-selection layer per b7z9.24.2, and the drift holdover check in lichen-link tdma_clock tests). Vector-file traceability via name-lookup find_case. Gates: 4/4 pass, clippy -D warnings clean on this test target, fmt applied. Reviews: 3x kimi-k3 over multiple invocations — findings addressed: wrap-arithmetic assert added (f4), invalid-beacon reset + consecutive coverage added, semantics-pin tests honestly relabeled; the reviewer's cross-crate observations (Rust lacks on_missed_superframe — R-02a-081 gap; multi_root FSM drive) remain tracked under parent b7z9.25's new child slices. Note: lichen-node lib tests remain unbuildable until ovhe (P0 oscore ContextId split) — that blocks ALL rpl_stack test compilation, not this slice.
